Maya R: proposal: replace monolithic intake adapters with a tiny model descriptor + isolated probe runners. static checks read descriptor only.
Jon P: sounds safer. how small is "tiny"?
Maya R: a few fields: model_id, tokenizer_sha256, max_seq, quant_hint, canonical_sample, provenance_tag. nothing policy-y.
Lina S: where do acceptance rules live then?
Maya R: policy engine in platform. descriptor just supplies hints; engine selects probe suites.
Jon P: runtime probes as containers or a shared binary?
Maya R: containers for security isolation. simple grpc contract: run_probe({descriptor, probe}) -> {score, logs, artifact_url}.
Lina S: cost concerns. we can't run deep probes for every upload.
Maya R: plan: tiered probes. quick checks auto-run, deep suites scheduled or gated by flags/usage.
onboard-bot: [deploy-bot] descriptor-lint queued for beta-9b, run=2026-03-22-05
Jon P: migration for existing adapters?
Maya R: synthesize descriptors from adapter metadata during a transition window; run observe-mode lint to surface issues before blocking.
Lina S: ok. please add a reproducibility tag so probes can be replayed for audits.
Maya R: will do. I'll open an RFC with schema + grpc spec + rollout plan and tag reviewers. :+1:
